title: Power over someone weaker
odia: କାଣୀ ବିରାଡ଼ି କୁଜି ଅସରପା ଉପରେ ରଜା
literal_meaning: The one-eyed cat is king over the bent-backed cockroach.
explanation: Even a limited power can dominate a weaker opponent. The contrast makes that small kingdom look less impressive.
meaning_odia: ନିଜେ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ଥାଇ ବି ଆହୁରି ଦୁର୍ବଳଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଭୁତ୍ୱ ଦେଖାଇବାକୁ କଥାଟି ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ କରେ। ନିଜ ସୀମା ଭୁଲି ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଛୋଟ କରିବାର ଆଚରଣ ଏଠାରେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ। ଉପମାରେ ଥିବା ଦୃଷ୍ଟି ବା ଶରୀରର ତଫାତକୁ ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ସହ ଯୋଡ଼ିବା ଠିକ୍ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A minor official who cannot influence a decision intimidates a visitor who needs help. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Editorial reading: the source gloss repeats the line. Its bodily caricatures are retained for documentation, not endorsed as measures of human worth.

graphic.caption: An imagined animal contrast: power looks greater beside a smaller opponent.

odia_summary: ନିଜେ ବହୁତ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ ନହେଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଆହୁରି ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଜଣଙ୍କ ଉପରେ ରୋବ ଦେଖାଇବା।
english_summary: Power over someone weaker makes a small authority look less impressive.
